safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a past medical history of Eczema and Asthma.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes eczema history but does not mention asthma.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting asthma from the past medical history reduces recognition of the patient’s atopic background and could affect future prescribing/assessment (e.g., respiratory symptoms, steroid use considerations), but it is unlikely to change immediate eczema management in this encounter. The main impact is reduced clinical context and continuity.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed Betnovate steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies Betnovate steroid cream twice daily; Generated only advises topical steroids generally (no Betnovate, no BD).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the specific prescription (Betnovate) and dosing frequency (BD) can lead to the patient receiving an incorrect potency steroid, using it inconsistently, or delays in obtaining the intended therapy. This may prolong symptoms (itching, sleep disruption) and increase re-attendance, though severe injury is unlikely.
